descricao: The paths of Level 39 randomly twist and curve, sometimes forming ineffective loops and curls. This feature of the level makes Wanderers easily lose their sense of direction. The paths within Level 39 are usually two meters (6.6 feet) wide. The oak trees of Level 39 have been observed to be immovable and indestructible. After further examination, it was confirmed that every single tree is not alive, and is instead an inseparable part of the level, since their roots gradually progress and fuse into the ground of it.
